findings.claim: The async functions deleteScheduledEmailReminder and deleteScheduledSMSReminder are called inside forEach loops without await. The call sites include handleCancelBooking.ts, handleNewBooking.ts, bookings.tsx and workflows.tsx. Because of this, reminder cancellation or DB updates may not complete before the request ends, and rejections are lost.

verifier.reason: Both functions are async and are called without await inside forEach at handleCancelBooking.ts:485-493, handleNewBooking.ts:966-972, bookings.tsx:488-494 and workflows.tsx:212-218, 376-382, 519-525, 574-580, so the Prisma delete/update they now perform is fire-and-forget. The patch removed the previously awaited `Promise.all` over the `workflowReminder.deleteMany` calls; the "rejections are lost" part is overstated, since both functions catch and log internally (emailReminderManager.ts:197+, smsReminderManager.ts:177+).

findings.claim: In handleNewBooking.ts the new try/catch wraps a forEach of un-awaited async reminder-deletion calls. As a result, the catch block and its log.error are unreachable.

verifier.reason: packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:964-975 wraps a synchronous forEach that calls deleteScheduledEmailReminder/deleteScheduledSMSReminder without await; both are async functions that also catch their own errors internally (emailReminderManager.ts:197-236, smsReminderManager.ts:177-190), and workflowReminders is always an array from the Prisma include (handleNewBooking.ts:772), so nothing in the try can throw synchronously and the log.error at line 974 is effectively dead code.

findings.claim: In deleteScheduledEmailReminder (emailReminderManager.ts), the immediateDelete=true branch cancels the SendGrid scheduled send and then returns. It neither deletes the workflowReminder DB row nor marks it cancelled, which leaves orphaned rows.

verifier.reason: The `immediateDelete` branch at packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:213-223 only posts the SendGrid cancel and returns, so the row is neither deleted nor marked cancelled. The rows are only stale temporarily, though: the workflow-delete and step-delete callers (workflows.tsx:214, 521) remove them by FK cascade, and the reschedule caller (handleNewBooking.ts:968) leaves the row only until the cron purge of past-dated email reminders (scheduleEmailReminders.ts:34-41).

findings.claim: deleteScheduledEmailReminder is called with immediateDelete=true on workflow deletion, step deletion and reschedule. This performs direct SendGrid cancellation that bypasses the deferred cancellation flow and is subject to SendGrid's cancelled-batch limit.

verifier.reason: `deleteScheduledEmailReminder(..., true)` is called at packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/workflows.tsx:214 (workflow delete), :521 (step delete) and packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:968 (reschedule); that branch at packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:213-222 POSTs a cancel to `/v3/user/scheduled_sends` and returns without setting `cancelled: true`, so it skips the deferred cron flow in scheduleEmailReminders.ts:43-77. SendGrid's cancelled-batch limit is external and not checkable here, but it is the limit the deferred flow exists to avoid, and a failed cancel is only logged (emailReminderManager.ts:233-235).

findings.claim: The cron cancel loop in scheduleEmailReminders.ts wraps all sequential SendGrid cancel calls in a single try/catch. One failed cancel therefore aborts the loop, skips the remaining cancelled reminders, and affects the queued row deletes.

verifier.reason: packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:53-77 wraps the whole `for` loop of awaited `client.request` cancel calls and the trailing `Promise.all(workflowRemindersToDelete)` (line 74) in one try/catch. A single SendGrid rejection at line 57 jumps to the catch, skipping every remaining reminder and never reaching `Promise.all`, so the lazily queued Prisma deletes for already-cancelled reminders are not run in that cron pass.

findings.claim: The cancellation query in scheduleEmailReminders.ts does not restrict to scheduled EMAIL reminders. A reminder with a null referenceId, or an SMS reminder, is passed to SendGrid as an invalid batch_id, which causes API errors and prevents its deletion.

verifier.reason: The query at packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:44-51 does lack method/scheduled filters, but `cancelled: true` is only ever written at packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:225-232, after the `!referenceId` early-return delete at :203-211, and every caller invokes it only when `reminder.method === WorkflowMethods.EMAIL` (SMS reminders are deleted outright in smsReminderManager.ts). So no SMS or null-referenceId reminder can be cancelled and reach the SendGrid call at :57-64; the missing filter is a defensive gap, not a reachable bug.

findings.claim: Cancellations in the cron are processed after the earlier delete-by-date logic. If the cron runs late, a cancelled reminder can be removed from the DB without a SendGrid cancellation request ever being sent.

verifier.reason: In packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:34-41 the cron first deletes every EMAIL reminder with scheduledDate <= now regardless of the cancelled flag, and only afterwards (lines 44-74) looks up cancelled reminders to send the SendGrid cancel. Because emailReminderManager.ts now only sets cancelled=true instead of cancelling immediately, a cancelled reminder whose scheduledDate has passed before the cron reaches it is deleted with no cancel request ever sent.

findings.claim: The patch uses prisma.workflowReminder.delete where callers previously used deleteMany. delete throws P2025 when the row is already gone.

verifier.reason: The patch removes the callers' `deleteMany({where:{id}})` calls (handleCancelBooking.ts, bookings.tsx, workflows.tsx) and replaces them with `prisma.workflowReminder.delete` at smsReminderManager.ts:182, emailReminderManager.ts:204 and scheduleEmailReminders.ts:66, which does throw P2025 on a missing row. Every one of those sites sits inside a try/catch that only logs, so the effect is a logged error rather than a crash.

verifier.reason: The same POST to /v3/user/scheduled_sends with {batch_id, status: "cancel"} appears in the cron at packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:57-64 and in packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:214-221; the patch adds the cron copy instead of reusing a shared helper.

findings.claim: twilio.cancelSMS and the row delete share one try block. If cancelSMS throws, the row is not deleted, whereas the old callers deleted it regardless of the Twilio result.

verifier.reason: In packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/smsReminderManager.ts:178-189, `twilio.cancelSMS` (line 180) and `prisma.workflowReminder.delete` (lines 182-186) sit in one try block, so a throw from cancelSMS (Twilio error or `assertTwilio` failing, twilioProvider.ts:48-51) skips the delete and is only logged. findings.claim: Deferred cancellation only sets cancelled=true and relies on the 15-minute cron, which cancels only reminders due within the next hour. A booking cancelled shortly before its reminder's send time, after the last cron pass, still gets the reminder email.

verifier.reason: With no `immediateDelete` flag, `deleteScheduledEmailReminder` only sets `cancelled: true` (packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:225-232), and the booking-cancel path calls it that way (handleCancelBooking.ts in the patch). The real SendGrid cancel happens only in the cron handler (packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:44-64), which runs every 15 minutes (.github/workflows/cron-scheduleEmailReminders.yml:8), so a booking cancelled after the last pass before `sendAt` still gets the email, and the next pass just deletes the past-due row (scheduleEmailReminders.ts:34-41).

findings.claim: The new 'cancelled' field on WorkflowReminder is nullable without a default of false, so existing records can have null values.
